item.text: {"experiment_interpretation":"The controlled history[3] interventions produce large, repeatable contrasts: 0.918 at E1 and 0.881 at E2, well beyond the ±0.03 noise-only contrast bounds. This supports a response dependence on the most recent history interval and rejects the executable C1/C2 formulas, which omit history from their fitted expression. C0 includes history[3] but its frozen contrast predictions are too large and its dev RMSE is poor; these results refute that fitted formula, not every model using history[3]. Fresh_1 also shows that changing the active history location changes response, and observed_A/B show history contrasts varying with h, so retain explicit history and h-by-history structure.
